details.evidence: I dwell in the upper reaches of the Yangtze, You in the lower reaches of the same stream.
details.reasoning: The translation explicitly contrasts the two locations (upper vs. lower reaches of the Yangtze) with clear head and tail positioning, fulfilling the requirement for spatial parallelism and opposition.

details.evidence: Day by day I think of you but cannot see you
